[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;60049207][spoiler=[b]Last Stages of Operations in Hydronia[/b]]The JDAMs continue to accurately target Hydronian oil infrastructure and transport infrastructure. Other guidance modes feed into the bombs guidance systems including laser designation and alternate navigation aids including terrain matching. While the jamming systems of Hydronia only cover L1, L2 and L5, the Kaiserreich uses M-code signals to null out the jamming sources. Use of alternate guidance and M-code allows the JDAMs to remain highly accurate in the face of ineffective Hydronian jamming. At the last stage, the Hydronians use laser homing missiles against the JDAMs. This isnt practical for several reasons. Laser homing requires the missile to lock onto a laser spot reflected from the target. The JDAM isnt painting a laser or distinct trackable laser signature while it's dropping. The small size, high speed and limited exposure time makes a laser lock on that much more improbable. The laser target isnt stable or continuous on JDAMs making interception with laser homing man portables very improbable and difficult. 

The Hydronian laser homing missiles would be highly ineffective again while used against the Gunslinger supersonic air to air missiles. Laser-homing requires a laser painted onto the target which is viable on slower moving vehicles. However, a supersonic and highly maneuverable missile would be nearly impossible to hold the laser spot onto. Supersonic AAMs can close the gap at extremely high speeds making it very hard to even react in time. Laser designation, missile launch and terminal guidance would all take a longer time than for the AAMs to reach the Hydronian jets. Hydronian jets wouldnt have the time to regroup as their laser homing interceptors fail to lock onto the missiles and the Gunslingers fly towards them. Gunslinger prediction methods would be solid with data not just from Nestorstaat but the multiple air engagements over Hydronian skies. Firing huge numbers of ineffective laser homing missiles, dependent on laser painting that is infeasible with supersonic and maneuvering missiles would just be a massive waste. 

The Donnerkeils easily bypass chaff, flares and jamming. Chaff effects on the cruise missile would be minimal as it doesnt utilize radar for terminal navigation. Using primarily GPS, INS, TERCOM and DSMAC that are passive and dont emit radar signals and are thus not confused by chaff. On jamming, the CRPAs onboard focus GPS emissions on the correct sources and work to null out Hydronian jamming to maintain constant GPS feeds. Even in the rare occasion that jamming does work the missile doesnt require mid-flight intervention due to pre-programmed routes. Flares have absolutely no effect on the missile since it doesnt use infrared tracking. 

The Reichswehr torpedoes are able to chase as deep as over 800 meters. Usually submarines hull crush points are above this limit(Virginia-class: ~600m). The torpedoes and UUVs are able to continue to chase the submarines without being crushed for several reasons. Smaller structures such as the UUVs and torpedoes experience fewer total pressure-induced stresses than larger submarines due to less surface area for pressure to act on. Unlike the submarines the smaller UUVs and torpedoes also dont need air systems, large cavities or complex internal compartments allowing them to structurally reinforce better for high pressure. The titanium casing also allows it to survive in high pressure environments. For these reasons the torpedoes and UUV swarms continue to chase the submarines even as they dive deeper. 

The Kaiserreichs artillery batteries utilize MRSI to cause multiple rounds to impact at the same time with the purpose of saturating the C-RAM defenses. Due to being fired at high-arcing trajectories the shells are able to descend at almost vertical rates to overwhelm C-RAMs with limited elevation coverage. Used against C-RAMs that typically fire towards lower-angle threats, these exploit blind spots in coverage. To degrade the C-RAMs ability to defend the troops, the Reichswehr jams frequencies utilized by the C-RAM along with utilizing spoofing to create multiple false targets. Multiple Reichswehr batteries fire GMLRS towards the C-RAMs in a kinetic strike following EW attacks to destroy the air defenses permanently. Reichswehr tanks fire their DU tipped rounds towards the APCs and Hydronian armored vehicles while aided by man-portable missiles and air to ground anti-armor missiles guided via laser painting. At long-range the Reichswehr THOR system fires high powered microwaves towards the approaching drone swarms to fry their electronics and make them fall harmlessly out of the sky. 

Mobile jamming would have little effect on the paratroopers' drones. The fire and forget systems dont require human input for the drones autonomous systems to carry out their missions. They continue to carry out their suicide attacks on Hydronian armored vehicles and personnel. Line-of-sight capabilities of the drones wouldnt be hindered as they would move past the phosphorous before attacking the Hydronians. The JDAMs continue to maintain their accuracy through M-code signals and terrain matching. The few seconds the Hydronians have to get away wouldnt be enough to avoid the airstrike. 

The Gunslingers continue to strike Hydronian aircraft as laser homing a supersonic maneuvering air-to-air missile doesnt make practical sense. Saturation through launching massive numbers of laser homing missiles wouldnt be effective but rather a waste since laser painting these supersonic missiles consistently just isnt possible. The ineffectiveness of laser homing against these missiles would likely mean a significant chunk of the 200 aircraft and helicopters would be destroyed. Even if stragglers try to destroy the SAMs with supposedly longer air to ground missile ranges this doesnt prove to work. The 100 km range of the air to ground missile is outmatched by the 160 km range of the FAS-3 giving the Reichswehr significant time to intercept the large wave of aircraft before they get close enough. With range on the Reichswehrs side, coupled with large stockpiles of interceptors brought in via Regent sealift the saturation attacks would prove not only a blunder but a waste. At the MANPAD stage flares wouldnt prove helpful to the Hydronians. The dual banded IR systems of the man portable missiles along with imaging infrared seekers would help the missiles keep a lock on the incoming helicopters. The laser homing missiles wouldnt be effective against the Gunslingers as previously described, with the UAVs continuing to fire at the remainder of the wave at before visual range. The wave of aircraft likely wouldnt be able to reach Reichswehr controlled territory due to the ineffectiveness of their laser homing missiles and being outranged by the FAS-3. 

The precision assaults and carpet bombing on the Reichswehr point defense would be dependent on the Hydronian air wave being able to break through which it wouldnt(doesnt outrange and laser homing doesnt work well on the interceptors). The man-portable missiles would be dealt with the SHORAD rocket systems which take them out before they are able to hit the point defense. Hydronian jamming would be bypassed using the M-coded system and others described above allowing the JDAMs to accurately track down industrial sites and small groups of personnel. The fire and forget nature of the suicide drones makes them impervious to jamming as they are autonomous systems allowing them to continue their attack. 

Before the ceasefire is adopted the Reichswehr launches yet another assault on Hydronian infrastructure. B-25ELs are dispatched to drop JDAMs onto strategic factories, ports, railroads, bridges and command centers. GBU-57s are dropped from a different group of B-25ELs onto various Hydronian nuclear sites ranging from nuclear enrichment facilities to missile silos to set back THEPs nuclear programs. Two Seewolf-class submarines launch a wave of 300 Donnerkeil cruise missiles into Hydronian territory to destroy even more infrastructure, mostly against the already targeted oil infrastructure in the south. Following the conclusion of the strike the Kaiserreich agrees to the Hydronian ceasefire offer.[/spoiler]

[b][i]ADDRESS TO THE CONFEDERACY OF LAMANDICA[/i][/b]

After what has been a tumultuous week for the Confederacy, we finally have some good news. We have integrated some of the land west of the Tanavaim River into Lamandica with a new region home to 8 million inhabitants. Additionally, many of those living west of Lamandicas borders, as well as refugees from various different places have allowed for a major influx of new citizens to Lamandica proper, with Lamandica expected to hit about 36 million inhabitants by the end of the year. A big change for what has been a mainly rural nation. Due to this, the Lamandican Government has issued the construction of brand new towns and cities built from scratch to house are growing population. The first two new towns, estimated to cost 11 Billion Pelops will be called Ioton and Orocumah, will be built on the outskirts of Taultion, and will be the first of many built across the Confederacy.

Also, the Lamandican Government has announced a 19 Billion Pelop project building 7 new crossings over the Tanavaim River into Lamandicas newest region including 1 road tunnel, 2 combined road and rail bridges. 2 rail crossings, and 2 road crossings. One road crossing will connect into Oranlight-Meadabec province, while the other six will cross from Titus province, with half of those connected into the Port Encrastle metropolitan area, the largest population center in this newly incorporated region. Construction on the Koch Logan Tunnel (the southernmost crossing and will be the longest tunnel in Lamandica when complete), the Marcus J. Walter Road & Rail Bridge (the longest bridge in Lamandica when complete), the General Nueces Memorial Road & Rail Bridge, and the Castiron Bridge are expected to start construction in the coming weeks.

While some sources voices great consearn that a group exists that are willing to work with and support the creation of a terrorist cell inside Nordiheims boarders, wich we aslo know basicly nothing about, other point out that there isen't a whole lot we can do at this time exept trying to aquire information about them.
